materialSettings.heightUsage: bump-only micro relief; not planetary terrain elevation

layout.biomeSplat: top-left RGBA: R grassland, G forest floor, B lakeshore/bed, A rock outcrop
layout.waterMask: top-right RGBA: R water, G deep water, B polar, A reserved

geographyMasks.worldMapping: The selected 384×384 source crop maps to the 240×240 metre local ground patch

sourceResolution: The compact PBR atlas uses 96px cells to keep the first landing download small; the source pack provides 1024px mobile and 2048px PC maps.
notes: Atlas cells are cropped into independent CanvasTextures at runtime.
Base Color and Emissive are loaded as sRGB; Normal, Roughness, AO and Height are loaded as linear.
Biome and water masks are decoded as data, not display color, and determine ground materials, trees, shorelines and water geometry.
The periodic tile-breakup mask modulates the PBR material shader to reduce visible repetition.
